utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — thanks, Rosa. We’re set for Saturday at 10 a.m. on the front porch; just bring gloves if you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren — I’m still hoping to line up a few more hands for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right — thanks for keeping at it. If you know anyone free, I’d really appreciate the help for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Tess — I’m still lining up a few helpers for the Saturday front-porch repair drive, and I’ll send the time and what to bring soon.

utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate it, and I’ll keep an eye out for your update about the time and what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still hoping to line up a few more helpers for Saturday on the front porch. If you know anyone who can lend a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask around, but I need the final time and a clear tool list before I can promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Oren — I’m happy to help with the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch. Just send me the time and what to bring when you know it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, thanks, Sam. I’ll send you the time and what to bring soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yes — I can help. What time should I be there, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Mina — could you come by at 10 a.m. on Saturday? If you can, bring a screwdriver and a pair of work gloves.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
